veranderings.rede: Two full clauses, each with its own subject and verb (Antarktika lê / ys bedek), are joined by 'en', so AWS 2017 requires a comma.

veranderings.voor: Dit is hoekom ons Antarktika saam met die ander ses kontinente tel.
veranderings.na: Daarom tel ons Antarktika saam met die ander ses kontinente.
veranderings.rede: 'Dit is hoekom' copies English 'that is why'; 'Daarom' is the natural Afrikaans form, keeps the meaning and saves two words.
Under the house AWS rule a comma goes before 'want' only when both halves have a stated subject; the first half here is a command with no subject, so it takes no comma.

vlae.teks: 'n Eiland is 'n stuk land met water aan alle kante wat nie een van die sewe kontinente is nie.
vlae.rede: The relative clause 'wat nie een van die sewe kontinente is nie' stands after 'kante', so a young reader may attach it to the wrong word; putting it straight after 'stuk land' would be clearer, but this reads like a decided definition, so it is flagged rather than changed.
